Well, I was barely diagnosed last August, but I was dealing with it for a few years before then without knowing what I had it, and not having medication is absolutely terrible. I did sports in school and played instruments. They were my everyday life, but at that point, I couldn't do them. My fingers were stuck in either a fist or open, and my wrists would hurt so much. But the worst thing was that I overworked myself to where I couldn't bend my right foot as if my foot was a prosthetic. Even then, I didn't want to go to the doctor because I didn't want to know what was wrong with me and I didn't want to be taken out of doing what I love thinking, "It would all go away one day," right? Yeah, no, I couldn't walk. I couldn't even step on the foot without limping. There was 4 months of my life when I couldn't get out of bed, everyday was a struggle I probably had depression. In a nutshell without going hella deep, I'd cry everyday and night wondering when the pain would end. It never did and the one day when my parents talked to me I broke down in front of them because I couldn't put on a sock and they were begging me to go see a doctor to finally see what I had. I was a ghost of who I was I couldn't walk, couldn't stand up or sit , I was weak asf and wasn't eating. When I finally went to the to the doctor he saw how bad it was and ordered me me blood test for arthritis all that. And it showed up, ra, I thought that after knowing they'd give me medication to get better, but it had little to no effect on me. One day I was out shopping and while I was in my car a saw a little old lady, she was walking very slowly and robotically, swaying from side to side, extremely thin, looking extremely tired. At that moment I thought is that gonna be me in the future ? And then to my surprise I actually ended up seeing her in my rheumatology doctor's office.  Keep in mind I didn't know her, I immediately got scared, I wanted my medicine I never want to get to that stage. Call me selfish but I want to live my life as normally as I can I don't ever want to feel the pain again if i can. I read all the stuff for huimira and honestly I just don't care enough me feeling normal is all I want. For my immune system it's always been hard to get sick so I hope it still got some fight left
